content.comment_body: Hello. Does anyone know what is the maximum SD card capacity supported by [product_name]?
Hi, from my understanding, you can use an SD card with up to 32GB of storage capacity.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. This is an English language forum, so please write your future posts in English. Thank you. The [product_name] supports SD cards with a maximum capacity of 32GB. Be sure to format the card in FAT32, otherwise the device will not be able to read or write data. Avoid using quick format.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking about the maximum SD card capacity supported by [product_name]. Several responses confirm 32GB is the limit. It is emphasized that the SD card needs to be FAT32 formatted, and quick format should be avoided to ensure compatibility. There are no concerns over official documentation; the main focus is on ensuring proper formatting and compatibility.
